quote.title: Get a quote
quote.intro: Choose the kind of work and the number of products for a rough estimate, then send your contact details and I will prepare an exact proforma.
quote.estimateNote: This is only a rough estimate; the final price is given in a proforma after I review what you need.
quote.estimateUnavailable: No estimate is available for this choice.
quote.detailsIntro: Enter at least one way to reach you.
quote.name: Full name
quote.messageHint: Tell me about the products, the kind of photos and when you need them.
quote.attachmentsHint: Up to 3 files — images (JPEG, PNG, WebP) or PDF, 10 MB each.
quote.thanksBody: I will get back to you soon through the contact details you gave.
quote.errorGeneric: Sending failed. Try again or message me from the contact page.
quote.errorRate: You have sent many requests; please try again a little later.
quote.errorQuantity: The number must be between {min} and {max}.
quote.errorFileCount: You can attach at most 3 files.
quote.errorFileSize: Each file must be smaller than 10 MB.
quote.errorFileType: Only images (JPEG, PNG, WebP) and PDF files are accepted.

proforma.title: Proforma invoice
proforma.approvedBody: Thank you! Your approval is recorded and I will be in touch shortly.
proforma.rejectedBody: Your answer is recorded. If you change your mind or need changes, message me directly.
proforma.expiredBody: Get in touch to receive a fresh one.
proforma.supersededTitle: A newer version has been issued
proforma.supersededBody: This proforma was replaced; please use the link to the new version.
proforma.errorGeneric: Your answer could not be sent. Please try again.
proforma.errorRate: Too many requests; please try again in a moment.
proforma.decisionHint: Approving or declining is recorded once.

booking.title: Book a session
booking.intro: Choose the kind of session, pick a free day and time, and leave your contact details. The booking is final once I confirm it, and you can follow it from the link you get.
booking.noDays: Nothing is free this month; try the next one.
booking.noTimes: No free time is left on this day.
booking.name: Name
booking.notesHint: The kind of product, where to shoot, anything I should know.
booking.errorGeneric: The booking could not be sent. Please try again.
booking.errorRate: Too many requests; please try again in a moment.
booking.errorNeedTime: Choose a day and a time.
booking.errorContact: Enter at least one way to reach you.
booking.thanksBody: Your booking is waiting for my confirmation. Keep this link: you can follow the booking and cancel it from there.
booking.pendingBody: Your request is recorded and waiting for my confirmation. Check this page again later.
booking.confirmedBody: Your time is final. If you cannot make it, please cancel from here.
booking.cancelledBody: If you still want a session, make a new booking.
booking.errorCancel: The booking could not be cancelled.
booking.errorTooLate: It is too late to cancel online; please get in touch directly.
booking.statusFailed: The booking status could not be read.
